info.name: Mujeeb 24 — Local PostgreSQL API
info.description: Collection صادقة لمسارات Mujeeb 24 القابلة للاختبار محليًا. لا تحتوي أسرارًا أو refresh token. استورد معها Environment المحلي واقرأ README-ar.md قبل التنفيذ.

exec: pm.test('200 liveness', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('200 readiness', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('200 Prometheus metrics', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('mujeeb_postgres_pool_total_connections'); });

pm.test('200 and token only in response body', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.data.access_token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(JSON.stringify(json)).not.to.include('refresh_token'); pm.collectionVariables.set('access_token', json.data.access_token); });
pm.test('HttpOnly refresh cookie is issued', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Set-Cookie')).to.include('HttpOnly'); });
pm.test('200 current principal', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: List accessible businesses — capture first business ID

exec: pm.test('200 memberships and business ID', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(items).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('business_id', items[0].business.id); });
pm.test('200 rotated refresh session', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const json = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('access_token', json.data.access_token); });
pm.test('204 logout', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); pm.collectionVariables.unset('access_token'); });

item.name: Begin channel provisioning — disabled configuration returns 422, not 501

exec: pm.test('422 when provisioning is not configured, never 501', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); });

item.name: Begin channel provisioning — enabled configuration starts SocialAPI OAuth

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set('provisioning_idempotency_key', 'postman-provisioning-' + Date.now());
pm.test('202 accepted provisioning session', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(202); });

pm.test('returns OAuth authorization URL without provider secrets', function () { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data.status).to.eql('pending_authorization'); pm.expect(body.data.authorization_url).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('provisioning_id', body.data.provisioning_id); pm.collectionVariables.set('provisioning_authorization_url', body.data.authorization_url); });
pm.test('200 canned replies', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('inbox_idempotency_key', 'postman-canned-' + Date.now());

pm.test('201 canned reply', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set('canned_reply_id', data.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('canned_reply_version', data.resource_version); });
pm.test('200 automation rules', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('201 constrained automation rule', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set('automation_rule_id', data.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('automation_rule_version', data.resource_version); });
pm.test('200 read cursor', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
